explanation: Matches CDC(n,0)⇒CJC(n,0) in Theorem 7 of arXiv:math/0608009 and BCW82. The Lean form is stated at a single field K, stronger than Theorem 7's all-fields form, but the docstring's [BCW82] implication holds at a fixed char-0 field by the standard argument. BCW82 itself was not read. JacobianConjectureProp K (Fin n) is the same claim of polynomial inverse under unit Jacobian.
